items.camp_name: Naba Uday Higher Secondary School, Nangal Bhanga.
Naba Uday Higher Secondary School, Nangal Bhanga.
Training of camp in-charge in the wake of COVID-19
Departmental list of camp wise designated officials received
Mechanism for necessary transportation arrangements (road, water and air) to ensure GR is transported in time to each of the designated camps established
Ensure that all measures of social distancing and other added actions as suggested in the addendum are ensured
Instruction issued for setting up of camps
Setting up of camps and provisions/functions of responsible departments reviewed
Setting up of Child Friendly Spaces and breastfeeding corners in designated camps reviewed
Ensuring special care is taken to evacuate home quarantined persons including separate camp arrangements
Camps are safe from all hazards and appropriate protection and vigilance arrangements being made
Grievance Redressal mechanism for collecting and addressing feedback/complains from camp inmates are established and functional at camp level
Real time instructions/directives to concerned departments to address grievances issued
Real time functional mechanisms for ensuring accountability in camp management are ensured
Closure of the camps declared considering the on-ground situation
Post Operation (Closure of camps) Visits conducted to assess the situation of the camps
Designated camps (particularly schools) are provided with resources/ support towards cleanliness post closure of the camps
Post closure review meeting conducted to understand challenges, gaps and areas of improvement in camp management
All related documents (needed for compliance) are properly managed
Departments are instructed to conduct internal debriefing on lessons learnt
